competitorWins: Ventusky is the deeper focused weather-visualization tool: clean, detailed maps of wind, precipitation, temperature, pressure, clouds and waves built from forecast-model data, with animated flows that make approaching weather easy to read, including views aloft for aviation-minded users. If your main job is reading the weather itself — especially wind and rain over the coming days — Ventusky's meteorological focus beats a generalist globe for depth.
description: Ventusky is a weather visualization platform: wind, precipitation, temperature and other weather maps built from forecast-model data, offered free with a premium option. It is weather-only — no flights, ships, cameras or satellite tracking. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: a free 3D globe that mixes weather with live flights, satellites, ships, 76,000+ cameras, earthquakes and wildfires — the whole planet, not just the weather.
